title: Capability evolution guidance and deterministic conversion coverage controls

surfaces.currentBehavior: Deterministically assigns every Swift service/Auth file and MCP source module in the configured scope to an initial user or operational capability, records source hashes, declared symbols and lexical coupling/read/write/observation/offline signals, and fails generation/checking when any source is unassigned or artifacts are stale.

acceptance: All 41 Swift service/Auth and 47 MCP source files are assigned
An unassigned or changed in-scope source fails generation/checking until reviewed

surfaces.notes: Capability assignment is source triage, not target port/schema approval.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Discovers repository-backed conversion surfaces, including the isolated Ledger target app/core/tests, separately isolated target composition, migration-core and test-support modules/tests, target MCP TypeScript projections, target contract configuration/resources, the two target query-port inventory control leaves, and the two comment-only target query logical-authority control leaves; applies bounded classification batches; detects disappearance and live source drift; validates evidence requirements, product authority and vertical-slice implementation dossiers; emits coverage/authority/slice audits; and enforces cumulative M0-M5 gates. Both target query controls are excluded from Firebase audit/repair discovery even when their contract prose names Firebase exclusions. Initial acknowledgment remains one-time; deliberate re-acknowledgment requires an exact reviewed acknowledgeSourceHash that matches the newly observed hash.

acceptance: Discovery and validation complete with zero structural errors or warnings
Every surface resolves through exactly one classification batch to reviewed product or technical authorities
Every registered canonical target spec appears in the reviewed crosswalk and stale generated authority artifacts fail checking

surfaces.notes: The explicit hash workflow prevents agents from silently blessing source drift after a characterized file changes. Product-authority roles prevent current or historical Firebase-era specs from silently becoming redesigned target authority. Slice gates prevent implementation/status claims from outrunning exact requirements, contracts, verification and evidence. Separate composition, migration-control and test-support module roots are discovered without placing any of them into Firebase runtime authority. Its deliberate READY changes add exact CONFIG discovery first for the target query-port inventory generator/test leaves and now for the target query logical-authority generator/test scaffolds; no Firebase-tool duplication, status change, or ownership change is claimed.
